paths.react: domain/ is pure TypeScript: no React. Put this in src/ui.
paths.react-dom: domain/ is pure TypeScript: no React. Put this in src/ui.
paths.react-router-dom: domain/ is pure TypeScript: no routing. Put this in src/ui.
paths.dexie: domain/ is pure TypeScript: no database. Put this in src/data.
paths.dexie-react-hooks: domain/ is pure TypeScript: no database. Put this in src/data.

patterns.message: domain/ must not depend on data/ or ui/. Dependencies point inward: ui -> data -> domain.

paths.react-router-dom: data/ knows nothing about routing. Put this in src/ui.

patterns.message: data/ must not depend on ui/. Dependencies point inward: ui -> data -> domain.

paths.dexie: UI never touches the database directly. Use the hooks and repositories exported from src/data.
paths.dexie-react-hooks: UI never touches the database directly. Add a hook to src/data/index.ts instead.

patterns.message: Import from src/data (its index) only. If what you need is not exported there, export it there.
